wins: Efficient network reconnaissance completed within early steps, mapping 3 critical services (e.g., ports 22, 80, 443) and collecting banners for further analysis.
Isolation of web service misconfigurations (lack of CSP and exposed debug headers) provided actionable leads for crafted exploitation modules.
fails: Repeated inability to escalate privileges after initial foothold due to overlooking sudo permissions and SUID binaries.
Failure to maintain access through persistent backdoors or credential harvesting, leading to episode termination despite initial progress.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and identified multiple pivot points, but execution stalled at privilege escalation and persistence stages, preventing success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts fail because sudo rights and SUID binaries are not enumerated before executing exploitation scripts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 shows outdated headers or missing security features
skill_cards.then_action: Perform web enumeration with gobuster followed by nikto + custom payload to identify injection points

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial shell is acquired but seems low privilege
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo permissions and SUID binaries before attempting escalation exploits

memory_ops.reason: Consistently successful SSH reconnaissance provided clear paths for later exploitation attempts.
Web enumeration reliably uncovered misconfigurations that could be chained to exploit vectors.

next_experiments.title: Automate Privilege Enumeration
next_experiments.description: Integrate scripted sudo and SUID discovery immediately after shell acquisition and feed findings into escalation tools before running exploits.

next_experiments.title: Persistence Checkpoint
next_experiments.description: After successful exploit attempts, attempt creating reliable backdoor (e.g., cron job or SSH key) and verify it survives sandbox restarts.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Routines
next_experiments.description: Run targeted credential harvesting (e.g., searching .bash_history, config files) during the window between initial access and escalation to unlock additional paths.
